correctness_argument: Issues #987 and #988 (and #1001 for the karyotype): a natural isolate of the Peter 2018 panel is built as a perturbation set off S288C, and three things the release states about it had no slot. (1) The two loss-of-function matrices call an isolate's allele of a gene a loss of function: 231,339 calls on 4,069 genes and 141,453 homozygous frameshift calls over the 971 phenotyped isolates, reproduced exactly by the builder (tests/torchcell/sequence/test_natural_isolate.py). NaturalLossOfFunctionPerturbation is a new leaf beside SequenceVariantPerturbation under SequencePerturbation, one perturbation per released call with its matrix pinned (call_ref), its row keyed as the release keys it, and what the inferred-allele release says about the same allele (allele_status: 204,038 on a variant, 26,510 with no inferred allele, 791 on an allele equal to S288C). (2) Supplementary Table 1 marks 124 isolates (122 phenotyped) HO-deleted and the paper calls them 'non-natural haploid with the HO gene deleted'; the deletion is engineered, so it is stored as a DeletionPerturbation of YDL227C, and for the 49 of them whose presence matrix marks HO absent (47 of the 122 phenotyped) it replaces the natural absence those genotypes carried, mislabeled natural. DeletionPerturbation was an abstract parent; it becomes a GenePerturbationType member because each of its children asserts a cassette Table S1 does not name, so it is the one deletion class that claims nothing unstated. Its fields and fingerprint do not change. (3) Ploidy, genome zygosity and whole-chromosome aneuploidy are not gene-keyed, so they go on Genotype.natural_isolate, an optional NaturalIsolateDescriptor whose every element is Table S1's value or a typed ProvenanceGap ('Xn' ploidy, the one empty 'Aneuploidies' cell, and the manipulation of isolates Table S1 does not mark, since the paper also says 93 external isolates were 'genetically manipulated and made homozygous' without naming them). The field is excluded from the dump when None, so every genotype that is not a natural isolate serializes to the same bytes and keeps its content id; a rebuild of the other stores re-writes identical records. Calls and the HO deletion name their gene by the systematic name in perturbed_gene_name, as the natural absences do, so a gene keeps one spelling within a store. The union gains two members, which re-stales every store whose closure holds Genotype (rule 7, accepted for a correct member).

alternatives_rejected.alternative: An optional consequence field on SequenceVariantPerturbation
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: 26,510 calls sit on genes with no inferred allele and 791 on alleles equal to S288C, so there is no variant to annotate; it would also change what a served class's records mean.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: NaturalLossOfFunctionPerturbation as a subclass of SequenceVariantPerturbation (the issue's leaf)
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: isinstance(p, SequenceVariantPerturbation) would count every call as a variant, and a call without an allele is not one.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Drop the calls with no inferred allele, or decide the 791 disagreements in favor of one release
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Each is a released call; the release does not say which matrix is right, so both statements are kept with the disagreement named in allele_status and gene_present_in_isolate.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Two cause members, nonsense and SIFT
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The release folds them into one bit and does not say which applied; the bit also holds every homozygous frameshift call on its genes (measured), so the member is nonsense_sift_or_frameshift.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: KanMxDeletionPerturbation or MarkerDeletionPerturbation for the HO deletion
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Table S1 and the paper name no marker; KanMX would be an invented cassette and MarkerDeletionPerturbation requires one.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A ChromosomeCopyNumberPerturbation in the gene-perturbation union (#1001's first proposal)
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Every consumer keys a perturbation by systematic_gene_name (gene sets, graph nodes, verifiers); a chromosome is not a gene.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A sibling genotype class for natural isolates
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: It would change the genotype field of five served experiment classes; an optional descriptor on Genotype changes none of their records.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Genotype.natural_isolate dumped as null on every genotype
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: It would change the bytes and content id of every stored genotype of every store, none of which is a natural isolate.
